name: You.com Web Search
summary: Discover and execute You.com web search capabilities for real-time information retrieval.
description: A recipe for finding You.com web search capabilities through QVeris, inspecting their parameters and quality metrics, then executing searches to get current web information with citations.

qveris.reason: Find You.com web search capabilities by natural-language search intent.
Read parameter schemas, billing rules, and quality metrics before execution.
Execute You.com search capabilities with user queries.
Review usage and billing records after search execution.

network.reason: Call QVeris API endpoints for capability discovery, routing, and execution.

secrets.reason: Authenticate QVeris API requests for capability discovery and execution.

marketplace.headline: Real-time web search with You.com through QVeris capability routing.

examples.name: CLI web search
examples.command: qveris discover "You.com web search API" --json | jq '[.results[] | select((.provider_name // "" | ascii_downcase | gsub("[^a-z0-9]"; "")) == "youcom")] | first'
